result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontally scrollable restaurant carousels ('Fastest near you' and the category chips) clip content at the right edge without any visual affordance (fade/gradient or partial peek), which can make it unclear that more items exist. A few minor cosmetic refinements are also possible.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') abruptly at the right screen edge with no fade, gradient, or scroll indicator, so users may not realize the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient overlay or ensure the next card peeks partially with consistent padding, plus a subtle scroll hint, to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same horizontal-scroll affordance (edge fade or peeking chip) so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: The notification/profile avatar in the top-right shows only a small red dot on an empty gray circle, with no visible icon or label; its purpose is ambiguous and the red dot may be missed by users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable profile/notification icon inside the circle and provide an accessible label; consider a larger or higher-contrast notification badge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis in the visible area, which looks slightly broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') or allow two-line wrapping for card titles.
